description: This is a Java test class for the DictionaryBackgroundLoader component, testing its background loading and reloading functionalities with mocked dependencies.

classes.name: DictionaryBackgroundLoaderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DictionaryBackgroundLoader's background loading and reloading methods.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Tests successful background loading of a dictionary, verifying the sequence of load and callback invocation.

methods.name: testFailedToLoad
methods.description: Tests the scenario where loading the dictionary throws an exception, ensuring proper cleanup and callback invocation.

methods.name: testReloadHappyPath
methods.description: Tests successful reloading of a dictionary in background, verifying load is called and close is not called.

methods.name: testReloadFailedToLoad
methods.description: Tests reloading when load throws an exception, verifying cleanup and callback invocation.
